comparison.objective: Mix two open test tubes safely by side-to-side waggling.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual tube grasping and repeated lateral agitation without vertical shaking or spilling.
comparison.success_condition: Both tubes reach the required swing count, return upright to the rack, and are released; excessive vertical strokes or tilt invalidate the run.
comparison.reason: Tests controlled liquid-container agitation. It does not test coaxial mandrel placement, impact fracture, retained-insert protection, or loose metal-fragment recovery.
